PP-LiteSeg-T with STDC1
======================

Upstream license: Apache License 2.0
Upstream source: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleSeg
Pinned revision: 3c4db66de1d9d59d0628ed87590b6308a2f4aa2a

Local modifications: OpenScaner ports the official PP-LiteSeg-T topology to
PyTorch: the STDC1 [2, 2, 2] backbone, sum-fused PPContextModule, spatial UAFM
decoder, and official T-channel widths. It changes the segmentation head to
one binary logit and trains on the shared deterministic generated dataset.
The official PP_STDCNet1 ImageNet parameters are checksum-verified and mapped
deterministically from Paddle parameter names into the equivalent PyTorch
backbone before training.

The verbatim upstream Apache License 2.0 text is packaged at
licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.
